* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-velkentezeri-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual7-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “[Pilot] 2. Smuggler. May not be attacked. Velken may not target Luke with weapons. Once per game, when deployed to a battleground, opponent must use or lose 2 Force. While present at a pit, may add 1 to Force drains here, and Sarlacc is ferocity +1.” '''What changed:''' nothing: the card image prints the release-sheet words again, word for word. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date). Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and set mark) and prints no slip number, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Velken Tezeri (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 15)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). While present at a pit, may add 1 to Force drains here, and Sarlacc is ferocity +1.” '''What changed:''' nothing: the Master List prints the release-sheet words again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (versions rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat; whatever was published last is current). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
